observations: A solid pink upright figure occupies the center against a black ground; jagged spike lines run along the top of the head and down the back, drawn in a lighter pink outline.
The snout extends far to the right, lined with a row of small triangular teeth along the lower jaw; a white concentric-circle eye sits near the snout's base.
A thick black wavy line cuts across the neck area, separating the head mass from the body, while shorter zigzag lines texture the torso's left edge.
reading: Pink fills a single upright form—long snout, spiked crest, jaw open wide with small triangular teeth. A thick black wavy line at the neck gives the figure a fractured quality, as if the head is barely held in place. The concentric-circle eye adds a fixed, almost mechanical stillness against an otherwise agitated outline. The mood reads as loud and unsettled.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #264 and nnxyz nnotb #266. All three share a spiked-crest and spiral-eye vocabulary on upright figures, though the palette shifts sharply—blue on deep red, then pink on black, then teal on dark grey.

nnxyz nnotb #266 repeats the zigzag crest and a small tangled-circle eye on a similar upright form, but the open toothed jaw and pink fill are absent, making the contrast in tension visible.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the thick wavy black line fall on the figure's body, and how does its weight compare to the lighter zigzag lines elsewhere?
ambiguities: The thick black wavy line at the neck could be read as a collar, a wound, or a structural break in the form; the image alone does not resolve which.
